route.change: Think-SFT with the cue at T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 and the cap raised to 32,768, three samples per problem; the answer is a sequential vote (samples 0 and 1, stop if they agree, else add sample 2, plurality, ties to the shortest finished sample), and tokens count only the samples the vote reads.
route.gap_parts: hard328 one-sample gap, cued base 161 to RL 207 (about 60 problems gross, shares from result-f39ba8's hard328 row): capability about .27 (~16 problems), which Think-SFT's imitated competition routines supply (one Think-SFT sample at cap 16,384 already 212 > RL 207); budget about .27 (~16), which the 32,768 cap gives back without a reward (Think-SFT 207 -> 230 on the same answers, result-c8b994); reliability about .43 (~26), which the vote over 2-3 samples recovers in part (Think-SFT vote +29 at 16,384). Answer statement (~2) is left alone. MATH-500: the gap is mostly reliability (.63), covered by the vote.
route.why: Think-SFT's teacher traces put whole solution routines for competition problems into the model, so it beats RL on hard328 without any reward; what it lacks is closing, which RL's difference supplies but which a longer budget plus agreement between samples also supplies at no reward.
route.command:
uv run tools/gpu.py submit l40s --hours 4 -- "bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.theory.jobs.free_cell --model think_sft --opening-text $' line!

Okay' --set hard328 --shard 0/5 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --max-tokens 32768 --samples 3 --seed 71000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.theory.jobs.free_cell --model think_sft --opening-text $' line!

Okay' --set math500 --shard 0/10 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --max-tokens 32768 --samples 3 --seed 72000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
route.rl_command:
uv run tools/gpu.py submit l40s --hours 4 -- "bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.theory.jobs.free_cell --model rl --opening-text $' line!

Okay' --set hard328 --shard 0/5 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --max-tokens 32768 --samples 3 --seed 71000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.theory.jobs.free_cell --model rl --opening-text $' line!

Okay' --set math500 --shard 0/10 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --max-tokens 32768 --samples 3 --seed 72000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
